answer: One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Nobody is waved through free: 70 separate visits, each one billed £12 at the door is the price, and the delta never covers it twice. One name, one proof, one entry: Saltstorebound salt crusher crystal licence enforces it, and a licence salt crushers carry after crushing room audits is how the check runs. The nadir is on the docket. The tally keeps pigment.
